decision: Fix git-control-tower review polling to pin the resolved API base for the lifetime of a review run. Proposed implementation: after the initial POST /review/run succeeds, capture the resolved base or require pollJob to use the same API base options that succeeded for the start request, so transient failures in DetectPortFromVrooli cannot make later status polls fail with an empty API base. Also print or preserve the job id before waiting so operators can recover status after a poll failure. Add a regression test that simulates a base resolver returning a valid base for the start request and empty on a later poll; review run should either continue using the pinned base or emit the job id with recovery guidance instead of losing the run.
rationale: Bug inbox knw-1778774971484367104 reported three GCT review runs that started and polled progress, then failed with 'polling job status: api base URL is empty', while explicit --api-base summary calls succeeded against http://localhost:18710. Scientific-debugging investigation found no prior fix recurrence. Code evidence: review run starts the job in scenarios/git-control-tower/cli/domains/review/register.go:80 and polls through pollJob at lines 97-111; every poll calls core.Get, which reaches packages/cli-core/cliapp/scenario_app.go:457-470 and packages/cli-core/cliutil/apiclient.go:26-36, reapplying APIBaseOptions on each request. API base resolution invokes DetectPortFromVrooli via packages/cli-core/cliapp/scenario_app.go:194-201 and :230-231, whose detector returns empty on any command failure per packages/cli-core/cliutil/port_detector.go:27-31. This explains a mid-run failure despite the API remaining reachable: the status poll re-resolves the base instead of reusing the base that already started the job. Direct patching is forbidden for bug-investigator, so this decision is the smallest durable action.
